clue.text: Owner tinted path unusually to enjoy celebration

indicators.note: unusually says the letters of these three words are arranged in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A homeowner has dyed the garden path an odd colour to mark a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusually' shuffles OWNER TINTED PATH; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom: to go out and have a riotous night of festivities.

clue.text: You or I manoeuvring planes on poor run

indicators.note: manoeuvring means moving things about, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Pilots steer aircraft along a bad runway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manoeuvring' rearranges PLANES ON POOR RUN; 'You or I' looks like people but names words of grammar.
explanation.definitionFit: Examples: these are words of grammar that stand for a speaker or the person addressed.

clue.text: Retain dialect found in country? On the contrary

indicators.note: found in would place the dialect inside the country, but the reversal phrase flips that relationship
on the contrary flips the statement, so the country sits inside the words retain dialect instead

explanation.surface: A speech form is kept alive in some nation.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, a dialect is found in a country; 'On the contrary' says the country is found in 'Retain dialect'.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain example: a large South Asian nation.

clue.text: One who keeps score gets everyone in row

indicators.note: in places the word for everyone inside the word for a row

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
everyone means all

explanation.surface: A scorekeeper gets the whole team lined up.
explanation.definitionFit: Agent noun: someone who tallies, counting points or votes.

clue.text: Hot and determined controller

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps
set means determined, as in set on winning

explanation.surface: A fiery, resolute person who controls things.
explanation.definitionFit: A hand-held remote device that operates a television or game is a controller.

clue.text: Gives away secret odds and ends and lets loose

parts.note: tat is cheap bits and pieces, junk

indicators.note: loose, as in let loose, says the letters of lets are set free into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone blabs, rambles on and lets everything slip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loose' looks like part of 'lets loose' but rearranges LETS into TLES.
explanation.definitionFit: To tattle is to gossip or tell tales, revealing what should be kept private.

clue.text: Psalmist's view of Moab, stood on height over basin

indicators.note: on, in a down clue, puts the first piece above the next
over, in a down clue, places this part above the next

parts.note: was can mean stood, existed
a pot is a vessel or basin

explanation.surface: A biblical poet's opinion of Moab, viewed from a hill above a valley.
explanation.walkthrough: Psalms 60 and 108 say 'Moab is my washpot', a bowl for washing in, a sign of contempt.
explanation.definitionFit: A quotation: the psalm literally calls Moab a washing bowl.

clue.text: Hope country shows play about robots and fairy being beheaded

parts.note: R.U.R. is Karel Capek's play that introduced the word robot

indicators.note: being beheaded means the first letter of the fairy's name is cut off

parts.note: Titania is the fairy queen in A Midsummer Night's Dream

explanation.surface: A country appears in a play about robots and a decapitated sprite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hope' is the novelist Anthony Hope, not optimism.
explanation.definitionFit: The imaginary kingdom where Anthony Hope set The Prisoner of Zenda.

clue.text: It's the item fixed first

indicators.note: first puts the word for fixed in front of the word for item

parts.note: fixed means definite, settled
an article is an item

explanation.surface: Someone points to the thing that was repaired before anything else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the' looks like an ordinary word but is the definition itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Grammar: this little word is the English determiner for something specific.

clue.text: Mars Socialist and French design beforehand

indicators.note: beforehand puts the word for design ahead of the French word

parts.note: red is a common label for a socialist
a plan is a design
et is French for and

explanation.surface: A left-winger and a French plan made in advance.
explanation.definitionFit: The fourth planet's nickname, from its rusty colour.

clue.text: Stroke's foot shoots back

indicators.note: back says the word for shoots is read the other way

parts.note: fires means shoots, as with a gun

explanation.surface: A swimmer's leg pushes off again.
explanation.definitionFit: In typography it is the short cross-line at the end of a letter's stroke.

clue.text: Everything goes on egg production unit

definitions.meaning: cryptically: if everything continues, nothing changes, read as O (nothing) plus a verb for changes
singular in the clue, while the answer is plural: the pair together make eggs

explanation.surface: A factory floor where egg production carries on regardless.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as O VARIES: if everything goes on, 'nothing varies'.
explanation.definitionFit: These female glands produce ova, the reproductive cells.

clue.text: Swift person jailed heartless US marshal?

indicators.note: heartless means the middle of the marshal's word goes, and the jailing word fills the gap

parts.note: a US marshal is a lawman
jailed means put away, locked up

explanation.surface: A quick-moving person has locked up a callous American lawman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' takes WM out of the middle of LAWMAN, and the word for jailed takes its place. 'Swift' is the satirist, not speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Swift's Gulliver visits the flying island of Laputa; an inhabitant bears this name.

clue.text: Partner to ram breakwaters regularly

indicators.note: regularly picks every third letter of breakwaters

explanation.surface: A ship rams harbour walls at intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: The female sheep is the mate of a male sheep.

clue.text: Machine's not American but red

indicators.note: not says the abbreviation for American is taken away

parts.note: an apparatus is a machine; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: A device that is foreign-made and painted red.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the Communist party machine, so 'red' plus the wordplay's machine both point at it.
explanation.definitionFit: This was the administrative machine of a Communist party, so it is red in the political sense.

clue.text: Plucked tail off Italian grub found on pet I love to hold

indicators.note: found on, in a down clue, places the first piece above the rest
tail off means the last letter is removed

parts.note: pizza is Italian food

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
a cat is a pet

explanation.surface: A diner removes the end of a pizza found on a pet they adore.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction: strings are plucked with the fingers rather than bowed.

clue.text: Hail falling in Mojave Desert

indicators.note: falling in says the answer drops into the words, lying inside them

explanation.surface: Hailstones come down in the Mojave Desert.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin greeting, as in Ave Maria, meaning hail.

clue.text: Return most of card holding metallic smooth material

indicators.note: holding says the reversed word wraps around the metal
return says the trimmed word is read backwards
most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: to card wool is to tease it
tin is a metal, used adjectivally as in tin roof

explanation.surface: Someone sends back most of a card that contains shiny metal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'card' is the verb for combing wool fibres, not a playing card; 'most of' drops the final E and 'Return' gives SAET.
explanation.definitionFit: A glossy fabric imitating satin, so a smooth material.

clue.text: Language having little advantage to American

parts.note: ad is the short form of advantage in tennis scoring

explanation.surface: A tongue that gives an American a small edge.
explanation.definitionFit: A programming language named after Ada Lovelace.

clue.text: Problem of heavy drinker with half pint instead of eight

indicators.note: instead of says one letter takes the place of another

parts.note: a guzzler drinks greedily
eight pints make a gallon, abbreviated G

indicators.note: half takes the first of the two letters in the abbreviation PT

explanation.surface: A boozer's trouble: only half a pint rather than eight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eight' means eight pints, a gallon, G; half of PT (pint) is P.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: something that baffles, a poser.

clue.text: Plain inhabitant wants ring back, left short of $100 by notorious fiddler

indicators.note: left short of means the hundred is removed from it
back says the word for ring is reversed

parts.note: to ring is to call by phone

Nero is said to have fiddled while Rome burned

explanation.surface: A prairie-dweller wants a ring returned, and was left a hundred dollars short by a famous violinist.
explanation.definitionFit: A dweller on the llanos, the plains of northern South America.

clue.text: Sharp scolding succeeded with members of crew

parts.note: a rating is a reprimand
S is the abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies

explanation.surface: A harsh telling-off worked on the ship's crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Naval term: ordinary sailors who are not officers.

clue.text: Tiger perhaps eating idiot with a sweet

indicators.note: eating says the cat swallows the idiot

parts.note: a tiger is an example of a cat
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A tiger devours a fool and a dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian ice-cream dessert with candied fruit, so a sweet.

clue.text: One who applauds striker

definitions.meaning: the tongue of a bell, which strikes it

explanation.surface: A fan cheering a footballer.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a person clapping, and the swinging part inside a bell.

clue.text: Drink celebrated return appearance

parts.note: sang can mean celebrated, as in sang the praises

indicators.note: return says the word for appearance is read backwards

parts.note: an air is an appearance or manner

explanation.surface: A toast celebrated someone's comeback.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish punch of red wine and fruit.

clue.text: Sound of drink causing trouble

parts.note: ale is a drink, beer

explanation.surface: Noise from drinking leads to problems.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb synonym: to afflict or distress, as in what ails you.

clue.text: Neat soldier hiding identity used by agent causing deterioration

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle, so an ox
a soldier ant
ID is short for identity

explanation.surface: A tidy soldier concealing who they are works with a spy who causes decay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat' is the old noun for cattle, not tidy.
explanation.definitionFit: Chemistry: an oxidising substance, which degrades materials like rusting metal.

clue.text: Girl you heard hire small band

indicators.note: heard means the word is replaced by a letter spoken the same way

clue.text: Stick in city to hit delinquent

clue.text: Elliptical barrel retained by old European

clue.text: 13, quarantined from relation, suggestive of kidney disease

erotic means suggestive
13-across is the female sheep

explanation.surface: A sheep, isolated from a relative, hints at kidney trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: The sheep straddles the join: nephEW Erotic loses EWE.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical adjective describing nephrosis, a disorder of the kidneys.

clue.text: Cover insane vote cast with Bush's persuasion?

explanation.definitionFit: George W. Bush's administration was associated with this hawkish right-wing political creed.
